svg.title: From an accepted phase to the voucher and its approval
svg.desc: Finance reads waiting phases and calls the payment gate, which asks FinanceFacts about the PO. A pass creates the voucher with the penalty and calls PhasePayment.started. The checker and approver act in turn. Approval calls PhasePayment.approved in the same transaction and records the spending on the ledger.
